title: MLFilter - Tooling API
description: Represents a data filter based on a data comparison in a machine learning (ML) application. For each comparison, there’s a left-hand element, an operator, and a right-hand element. Available in API version 50.0 and later.

FilterName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

LhFilterId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
LhFilterId.description: ID of the left-hand filter condition. This is a relationship field.

LhPredictionField.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

LhType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
LhType.description: Indicates the value type if a left-hand value is specified. Valid values are: Boolean Comparison Currency Date DateTime—Datetime Number String Supplier Varchar

LhUnit.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
LhUnit.description: Indicates the unit if a left-hand filter is specified. Valid values are: Days Hours Milliseconds Minutes Months Seconds Weeks Years

LhValue.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

Operation.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Operation.description: Specifies how to filter the data. Valid values are: Add And Between Concat Contains Divide DoesNotContain EndsWith Equals GreaterThan GreaterThanOrEqual In IsNotNull IsNull LessThan LessThanOrEqual Multiply Not NotEquals Or StartsWith Subtract

ParentDefinitionId.description: The ID of the MLRecommendationDefinition, MLPredictionDefinition, or MLDataDefinition that this MLFilter belongs to. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

RhFilterId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
RhFilterId.description: ID of the right-hand filter condition. This is a relationship field.

RhPredictionField.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

RhType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
RhType.description: Indicates the value type if a right-hand value is specified. Valid values are: Boolean Comparison Currency Date DateTime—Datetime Number String Supplier Varchar

RhUnit.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
RhUnit.description: Indicates the unit if a right-hand filter is specified. Valid values are: Days Hours Milliseconds Minutes Months Seconds Weeks Years

RhValue.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

SortOrder.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
SortOrder.description: Specifies the order of operations for evaluating the expressions. For example, if you have two conditions, this field specifies which condition is evaluated first.
